item.description: Breath of the Wild has a very medieval philosophy: that if the princess was a good woman, the land would prosper. We look at real history and it’s not that simple. Fujibayashi can say that Zelda became princess and reigned for a hundred years, and she was wise and good. But Fujibayashi doesn’t ask the question: What was Zelda's tax policy? item.title: dragon's dogma 2
item.description: There's a plot point in this game where you learn that the bad guy wants the McGuffin to control you, the dragon and your pawns and then the quest says "give the McGuffin to the obviously bad guy" and you need to do it to proceed.
